warm_individual_prototypes.scope: Simulation only, initialized cores, one process; three repetitions; middle repetition reverses order; compare median of last two; snapshots outside timing. Combined includes all three prototypes, including regressing collision culling.

fresh_process_final_patches.scope: Loading/JIT/decode/simulation/terminal hash validation; three fresh processes per command, no warmup, grouped baseline first; no competing benchmark/build. RSS includes Node and buffers; no browser memory claim. CPU counters include Node threads.

memory_caveat: Uninstrumented long-run means: baseline 153.4 MiB, optimized 171.5 MiB. Reversed order with GC traces: baseline 167.2 MiB, optimized 157.7 MiB. GC/runtime variability dominates the 9216-byte cache; no reliable RSS improvement or regression established.

memory_diagnostics.scope: Second three-run long-replay experiment; optimized first, baseline second; Node --trace-gc enabled and output captured. Diagnostic repeat, not pooled with uninstrumented timing samples.
memory_diagnostics.note: Both final-run GC logs show approximately 31.9-32.0 MB live Node heap after collection and 2621440 WASM bytes at replay end. RSS mean ordering reverses between experiments; no reliable memory gain or regression established.
